quiet.description: Seconds of output silence before control returns to me (default 10). The command keeps running — I MUST call shell_wait to resume. I lower it when I expect a quick command; raise it for ones with long silent phases.

max.description: Wall-clock seconds before returning control; the command keeps running. Default 120.

head.description: I receive only the first N lines of output (the user keeps their own view of it). Combine with `tail` to see both ends.

tail.description: I receive only the last N lines of output (the user keeps their own view of it). Combine with `head`. When neither is set, the last ~200 lines are returned by default. Prefer this over piping to `tail` in bash.
